entries.german:
1279. 0. T. Rosenberch. — Derselbe schenkt demselben die Kirche zu Rosenberg.

XXVI. Bone rei datur consilium, ut presentis uite conferatur sub- sidium, vbi eterne remuneracionis premium exspectatur. Sciant 32 igitur presentes ac posteri, quod ego Heinricus de Rosenberch pre- ceptis diuinis et salutaribus informatus domui sánete Marie virginis in Hohenfurt, quam pater meus pie memorie dominus Wokko multa beniuolencia cepit construere et fundare, ecclesiam in Rosenberch post mortem et obitum domini Jacobi plebani sacerdotis libcraliter omni iure, quo ipsam tenuit et possedit, tradidi perpetuo possiden- dam, vt fratres ibidem domino iugiter seruientes et pro salute mea atque progenitorum et successorum meorum fideles ad dominum intercessore» non alicuius necessitatis occasio aut desides faciat, aut robur sanete conuersacionis quod absit, infringat, quia plurimis indi gent, qui indigencias plurimorum conantur fideliter releuare. Vt autem bec rata permaneant et nulla queant inposterum calumpnia perturbari, preseötem cartam ipsis tradidi mei sigilli munimine robo- ratam cum testibus subnotatis, qui sunt: Dominus Andreas miles, Leupoldus, dominus Benata miles, Onscho ipsius Crater, Nycolaus, Vlricus de Weischel et eius frater Bseborius, Troyanus suisque fra- tribus et alii quam piures. Actum anno domini M° C° C° lxx° vnij° indictione sexta cpacta XXa quinta. Datum in Rosenberch. Gut erhaltenes an Pergamentstreifen hängendes Siegel wie ¡n XXK.
entries.english: Heinrich von Rosenberg, instructed by divine and salutary teachings, gives to the house of Saint Mary the Virgin at Hohenfurt the church at Rosenberg, after the death of Lord Jacob, priest and parish priest, with all the rights by which Jacob held and possessed it. Heinrich’s father, Lord Woko of blessed memory, had begun and founded the house. Heinrich grants the church to the monastery to possess perpetually, so that the brothers serving the Lord there may faithfully intercede with God for the salvation of Heinrich, his ancestors, and successors, and so that no need or neglect weaken the strength of their holy life. He gave them this charter, confirmed by his seal, to keep the grant firm and free from future challenge. Witnesses: Lord Andreas, knight; Leupoldus; Lord Benata, knight, and his brother Onscho; Nycolaus; Ulrich von Weischel and his brother Bseborius; Troyanus and his brothers; and many others. Enacted at Rosenberg in 1279. The well-preserved seal hangs from a parchment strip and is like that described in no. XXII.
